name: Twitch
author: Jonas Mohr
description: Provides access to Twitch, the well-known streaming service

settings.title: Twitch token
settings.summary: Twitch OAuth token to use for authentication against the helix API

settings.title: Use token for kiosk
settings.summary:
Whether to use the provided token to fetch data for the kiosk.
Not using a token will only show the top 30 streams.

settings.title: Use token for search
settings.summary:
Whether to use the provided token to fetch search results.
Not using a token will only show the first ~30 results.

settings.title: Use token for categories
settings.summary:
Whether to use the provided token to fetch the streams of a category.
Not using a token will only show the top 100 streams.

settings.title: Use token for clips
settings.summary:
Whether to use the provided token to fetch the clips of a channel.
Not using a token will only show the top 100 clips.

settings.title: Use token for vods
settings.summary: Whether to use the provided token to fetch the vods of a channel.\nNot using a token will only show the ~30 latest vods.
